questions.de: Welche geometrische Form hat das Bauwerk, in dem sich Landschaftskünstler Fürst Hermann von Pückler-Muskau beisetzen ließ?
questions.en: What geometric shape is the structure in which the landscape artist Prince Hermann von Pückler-Muskau had himself buried?

timeline.labelEn: Prince Pückler builds the Seepyramide (lake pyramid) in Branitz Park as his tomb
timeline.labelDe: Fürst Pückler legt die Seepyramide im Branitzer Park als seine Grabstätte an

questions.notes: He lies in the Seepyramide (an earthen pyramid tumulus in a lake) in Branitz Park near Cottbus, buried there on 9 February 1871.

questions.de: Welche Nerven des menschlichen Körpers haben zervikale, thorakale, lumbale, sakrale und kokzygeale Paare?
questions.en: Which nerves of the human body have cervical, thoracic, lumbar, sacral and coccygeal pairs?

timeline.labelEn: Bell and Magendie show that the spinal nerve roots carry motor (front) and sensory (back) fibres
timeline.labelDe: Bell und Magendie zeigen, dass die Spinalnervenwurzeln motorische (vorne) und sensible (hinten) Fasern führen

questions.notes: Usually 31 pairs: 8 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar, 5 sacral, 1 coccygeal (en.wikipedia 'Spinal nerve'). Timeline from en.wikipedia 'Bell–Magendie law'.

questions.de: Wie lautet der Fachbegriff für äußerst fein gewürfeltes Gemüse?
questions.en: What is the technical term for extremely finely diced vegetables?

timeline.labelEn: Escoffier's A Guide to Modern Cookery defines cutting 'brunoise-fashion' as cutting into small dice
timeline.labelDe: Escoffiers A Guide to Modern Cookery definiert das Schneiden „brunoise-fashion“ als Würfeln in kleine Stücke

questions.notes: Cubes of about 1–2 mm. Timeline from the 1907 English edition of Escoffier on Project Gutenberg (#71395); the term is older, but its first attestation could not be verified.
